Seasonal selections use source-defined regional route phases. Month coverage is incomplete; unresolved month ranges appear only when selected by phase name. These drawings do not provide observed monthly fields, annual extrema or uniform current widths. Exact observation dates use a separate selection.

Width samples retain different source metrics. Ordering their values does not establish a global width ranking. Plot-reading intervals are extraction allowances, not measurement confidence intervals.

Recorded links and computed geometry are separate queries. Spatial predicates use approximate, land-masked OSW display polygons; intersection includes boundary contact. Locators and gateways require their own modes. These are not physical current passage or full-current containment. Width records retain their region, layer and boundary definition; ordering them does not make a uniform width ranking.
